definitions.explanation: A pleasant, friendly manner toward others; sociability.
Polite attention or consideration shown to guests or customers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{愛想|あいそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
{愛想|あいそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}りまく⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧だ。
examples.english: She's good at being charming to everyone.

examples.japanese: {愛想|あいそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{尽|つ}きた→尽きる：12365_tsukiru⟧。
examples.english: I've lost all patience./I've had enough.

examples.japanese: {愛想|あいそう}⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{接客|せっきゃく}→接客：12882_sekkyaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To serve customers with a friendly attitude.

examples.japanese: {愛想|あいそう}⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: She greeted the guest with a social smile.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{愛想|あいそう}のうちだ。
examples.english: Serving tea is part of showing hospitality.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {愛想|あいそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ - friendly, amiable
- {愛想|あいそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ - unfriendly, cold
- {愛想|あいそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}りまく - to be charming to everyone
- {愛想|あいそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{尽|つ}きる→尽きる：12365_tsukiru⟧ - to lose patience, be fed up
- {愛想|あいそう}⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧ - forced smile, social smile

USAGE:
{愛想|あいそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ describes someone who is pleasant and approachable in social interactions. {愛想|あいそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{尽|つ}きる→尽きる：12365_tsukiru⟧ is an important idiom meaning one has completely lost patience or affection.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{愛嬌|あいきょう}→愛嬌：07293_aikyou⟧ - charm, lovableness (more about personal charm)
- ⟦{無愛想|ぶあいそう}→無愛想：07294_buaisou⟧ - curt, unfriendly (antonym)
